task.title: Ring gauntlet
task.goal: Take off, then fly through 5 rings in order. Each ring is a vertical circle of 60 m radius, passed by flying through it in its heading. They change with the seed: anywhere around the airfield, at very different heights, each facing its own way, so each needs a turn to line up with it. No landing needed. The aircraft is a Cessna 172 airplane: it lifts off at about 55 kt after a takeoff roll, stalls below about 48 kt and lands on a runway at 55-80 kt.
